rationale: CNC-102 is expected to be down for about 45 minutes, directly impacting ORD-7712, which is currently scheduled there. Moving ORD-7712 immediately to CNC-104 (SCN-A) keeps the urgent work fully on time and maintains a strong cushion before its due time, with only a modest increase in changeover usage and no hard constraint issues. Waiting for CNC-102 (SCN-B) or delaying the start on CNC-104 (SCN-C) both reduce urgency coverage and due-date buffer for small gains in simplicity or flexibility that are not critical here.
